name: Dried Pineapple
siboNotes: Low FODMAP option that provides natural sweetness without triggering symptoms. The dehydration process concentrates sugars but doesn't create problematic FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added high FODMAP sweeteners
Check labels for added sugars like high fructose corn syrup
Store in airtight container to maintain texture
Can be chopped and added to low FODMAP cereals or yogurt
